Squidlor is the unified oracle data layer one integration to query, compare and verify data across every major oracle network, built for institutions, protocols and AI agents.

Oracle infrastructure secures over $30 trillion in cumulative transaction value, yet access remains fragmented across six-plus networks Chainlink, Pyth, RedStone, Supra, eOracle and UMA each with its own API, schema and update model. No unified query layer, no way to compare feeds, no clean path to verify a number's origin.

The fix isn't another oracle  it's the access layer on top. Every request runs one flow: Request, Query, Compare, Verify. Data is pulled from all providers in parallel, compared for divergence, scored for confidence, and delivered as one verified answer with source, timestamp and provenance preserved.

Developers integrate through one API or on-chain contracts. AI agents connect via MCP in natural language. Products embed TradingView-style charts and widgets. Coverage spans crypto feeds and on-chain equities and the same layer powers prediction markets on tokenized stocks, settling automatically against verified prices.

Live on Arc mainnet as the first utility project of the Virtuals expansion.

One query. Multiple oracles. One verified answer.🦑
